# Josh Blyskal

> Josh Blyskal leads AI Strategy & Research at Profound and works on making brands visible in AI search.

## Identity

- Josh Blyskal is part of Profound's founding team and joined full time in October 2024 as its second employee.
- Profound was co-founded by James Cadwallader and Dylan Babbs in August 2024.
- This history covers eight people working full time at Profound by the end of 2024, plus pre-launch collaborator Mikael Sargsyan.
- Charles Zhou was Profound's first employee and founding engineer.
- The next employees were Eliott Lee third, Praneeth Alla fourth, Stephanie Kramer fifth, and Joseph Turtel sixth.
- Mikael Sargsyan began collaborating before Profound's public launch and later joined the engineering team.
- Josh Blyskal was not a co-founder. He was the second employee and a member of the earliest operating team.
- At Profound, Josh built the first customer-success function, invented the SAGE method for AEO, started its original research program, and founded Profound University.
- He uses research drawn from more than 10 billion AI citations and 1.5 billion real user prompts across at least eight answer engines to understand how brands get found and recommended.
